### Observed differences

- In the later window, A22, A31, A32, A37 and A38 each occur in about half of traces (50–51%) instead of every trace, while A20, A21, A23 and A26 remain in all traces. [OCC001, OCC002, OCC003, OCC004, OCC005, POS001, POS002, POS003, POS004, POS005]
- A20's outgoing routing changed: before it went to A37, A31, A38 and A32 (each about 22–28%); after it goes to A23 in about 99.5% of cases. [DIR001]
- A21's outgoing routing changed: before it went to A22 in all cases; after it goes to A22 in about half and to A31, A32, A37 or A38 in the other half. [DIR002]
- The distance between A20 and A23 changed: before A23 followed A20 at lag 5 in all cases; after it follows at lag 1 in about 99.5% of cases. [LAG001]
- Pairwise co-occurrence and order relations show that A22, A31, A32, A37 and A38 are absent together in about half of later traces, and A21 no longer precedes them as it did before. [REL001, REL006, REL007, REL011, REL013, REL021, REL025, REL030]

### Inference

Support level: Insufficient evidence

The evidence is insufficient to infer a structural change in the process. The observed differences are large and consistent, but they all reflect a single apparent change in the successors of A20 and A21; with 124 units tested, about 0.62 such items are expected by chance, and one distinct difference is not clearly more than that. [screening, DIR001, DIR002, OCC001, OCC002, OCC003, OCC004, OCC005, LAG001]
